headline: Analysts Lower DBS and Singapore Bank Target Prices on Weaker 2027 Outlook
summary: Equity analysts cut target prices for DBS and UOB after Q3 financial results missed expectations. Analysts cite lower projected 2027 earnings growth, though some note potential buying opportunities following recent share price drops.
why: DBS and UOB are Southeast Asia's largest lenders by assets and key indicators of regional credit demand and banking profitability.

impacts.name: DBS Group Holdings
impacts.why: Earnings misses and lowered 2027 profit forecasts prompted Wall Street sell-side price target reductions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Third-quarter earnings misses and cautious forward earnings outlooks caused selling pressure across Singaporean banking stocks.
